'''Topaz''' is a type of [[Minerals|Mineral]] that can be obtained from [[Mining#Mining Nodes|Topaz Nodes]] and [[Mining#Mining Nodes|Gem Nodes]] in [[The Mines]], from a [[Ginger Island#Gem Birds|Gem Bird]] on [[Ginger Island|Ginger Island]] during [[Weather#Weather Types|rainy days]], from [[Pans|panning]], or found in [[Fishing#Treasure Chests|Fishing Treasure Chests]]. It has a 10% chance to be dropped by a slain [[Dwarvish Sentry]] in the [[Volcano Dungeon]]. It may occasionally be found in a [[Garbage Can]].

==Bundles==
Topaz is one of the options for the {{bundle|treasure hunter||y}}.

==Forging==
Topaz can be used at the [[Forge]] to increase the defense of a melee weapon.

==Recipes==
Topaz is not used in any recipes.

==Tailoring==
Topaz is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] with [[Cloth]] in the feed to create a {{Name|Shirt146|link=Tailoring{{!}}Shirt|class=inline}}. It is a gold dye when used in the spool of the Sewing Machine with a dyeable clothing item in the feed. It can be placed in the yellow dye pot at Emily's and Haley's house for use in [[dyeing]].

==Quests==
*Topaz may be randomly requested during any season at the [[Quests#Help Wanted Quests|"Help Wanted" board]] outside [[Pierre's General Store]] for a reward of {{Price|240}} and 150 [[Friendship]] points.
*Two Topaz may be requested by [[Catfish]] in a [[Fish Pond#Quests|Fish Pond quest]] to increase the capacity of the pond from 3 to 5.
*Topaz is requested by [[Emily]] as part of her [[Quests#Rock Rejuvenation|"Rock Rejuvenation" special order]].
*May be used in the [[Ginger Island#Gem Birds|Gem Birds]] puzzle on Ginger Island.
*Three Topaz may be requested by the Raccoon at the [[Giant Stump]] as part of his fifth request, or as part of any request starting with the sixth.
